data.title: Moving a terminal from peak recovery to peak readiness
data.summary: A Laem Chabang container terminal connected gate, yard, and crane data so peak planning started before the queue formed.
data.challenge: Terminal teams relied on separate gate, yard, and crane systems. Planners saw the consequences of congestion after it appeared, and every peak shift ended with manual reconciliation.
data.strategy: We defined one operational event model across the three systems, then built a controlled integration layer rather than more point-to-point links. A small planning cockpit was designed with dispatchers and tested against a live peak window.
data.implementation: Gate OCR events, yard moves, and crane cycles were streamed into a shared event bus with observability and replay. Dispatch received a fourteen-hour look-ahead, and exception alerts replaced end-of-shift reconciliation.
